## Observable problem

Describe the exact behavior or rule gap and include a minimal safe fixture.

## Change

Explain the smallest implementation or documentation change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Positive fixture
- [ ] Nearby negative fixture
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Five-minute demo
- [ ] Release validator
- [ ] No target execution, network call, credential, or publication action

## Claim boundary

Confirm the change does not describe findings as proof of safety, malicious intent, correctness, or exploitability.
